info.name: Van Sales - Salesperson Mobile API
info.description:
REST API for the Van Sales salesperson app (Odoo 19, module van_sales_mobile_api).

1. Set {{base_url}} (e.g. http://95.216.142.99:8089).
2. Run Login - the token is stored automatically.
3. Requests that create something store its id ({{order_id}}, {{invoice_id}}, ...) for the next ones.

Every response: {success, message, data, error, pagination (lists)}.
Status: 200 ok, 201 created, 400 bad input / business rule, 401 token missing or expired, 403 not allowed, 404 not found or not his, 409 wrong state / no van / duplicate, 500 server error.
Lists: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100).
Empty values are null. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; datetimes in the salesman's timezone.
Every example response in this collection was returned by the server during testing.

Running the whole collection top to bottom: set {{product_id}} to a normal product the van carries. Cancel order and Return request then answer 409/400 by design (see their descriptions).
